run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, search-index-only run (same network constraint as recent runs). The session's network policy again blocked ALL direct HTTPS egress to tender portals and detail pages: WebFetch/DNS failed with ENOTFOUND for every .gov.au host (tenders.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, etc.) and every e-sourcing platform, so discovery was limited to the WebSearch tool. WebSearch is US-indexed and returned mostly stale (mid-2026) cached snapshots, JavaScript-disabled portal shells, and third-party aggregator pages. Tier 1 (Commonwealth AusTender, NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, WA/SA/TAS/NT/ACT) were all swept via search; no directly-verifiable NEW open government notices from the last 7 days could be confirmed. Tier 2 (councils, universities, water/energy utilities) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP/Rio Tinto/Woodside/Fortescue, Woolworths/Coles, Qantas, Telstra, EstimateOne) were checked via search; all corporate channels remained login/registration-gated with no publicly-visible open RFx. Only two opportunities could be captured responsibly this run: one confirmed closing-soon (ACARA Website Development Services, closing 9 Nov 2026 per ACARA's own tenders page) and one fresh buyer-originated panel signal (DTA Digital Marketplace Panel 2 reopening). An ACARA NAP-ICTL 2028 RFT surfaced but its own RFT document states tenderers must have received an email invitation, so it is invitation-only and OUT OF SCOPE (not captured). Two genuinely new buyer-originated council sources were identified for the source set.
gaps: CRITICAL ACCESS LIMITATION (repeat of prior runs): the session's network policy blocked all direct HTTPS egress and WebFetch. DNS did not resolve (ENOTFOUND) for www.tenders.gov.au and every other tender host, meaning they are outside the session's allowed network domains. No tender portal, detail page or tender document could be opened directly. Hosts needing allow-listing include www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au / buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, estimateone.com, buyict.gov.au, acara.edu.au and all illion TenderLink council portals.

Because direct access was blocked, ALL discovery was via the WebSearch tool only. Both captured entries are headline-level: deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents and contacts could not be extracted from source documents and are null. They need a deliverables/detail pass on the live buyer portal once access is available.

The web-search index was heavily skewed to stale/cached snapshots (mostly mid-2026). Live portal pages returned JavaScript-disabled shells with no listing content. Very few opportunities could be confirmed as open or published in the last 7 days.

AusTender (Commonwealth): no confirmable NEW November-2026 ATM found via search; recent ATM examples in the index were from 2024-2025. Federal coverage is a gap this run, deferred to a future run with portal access.
Tenders SA: search again largely returned South African ('SA') and stale closed items; no confirmable open South Australian government RFT. SA coverage is a gap this run.

ACARA NAP-ICTL 2028 Technology Solution (RFT 5-26) surfaced in search (aggregator ID 625217), but ACARA's own RFT document states 'tenderers must have received an email invitation to Tender from ACARA to participate' — this is an invitation-only / closed RFx and is therefore OUT OF SCOPE. It was deliberately NOT captured as a tender (no fabrication).

DTA Digital Marketplace Panel 2 (DMP2) reopening: captured from a buyer-originated announcement, but the exact November-2026 application window (open/close dates and the industry-briefing date) could NOT be confirmed via search (the index mixed 2024/2025 DMP2 rounds). The entry is flagged recently-published/panel with dates null pending verification on buyict.gov.au.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside, Woolworths/Coles, Qantas, Telstra) mandatory check completed: no publicly-visible open RFx found; all are login/registration-gated. Portals already recorded in the known source set (access_method=portal-registration). Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

Tier 2 councils/utilities: several VendorPanel/TenderLink councils and water/energy GBEs (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, Transgrid, Ausgrid) were checked via search; only closed/older EOIs were visible. No current open opportunity could be confirmed. Deferred to a future run with portal access.

tenders.title: Request for Tender - Website Development Services (RFT 8-26)

tenders.description: ACARA is seeking a supplier to provide website development services. The opportunity is published on ACARA's own tenders page with a closing date of Monday 9 November 2026, 3pm (Sydney time).
tenders.submission_method: Via ACARA tender process as described on the ACARA tenders page
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced via WebSearch against ACARA's own tenders page (acara.edu.au/about-us/tenders), which lists a closing date of Monday 9 November 2026, 3pm Sydney time for Website Development Services. Buyer-originated source. Carried forward from the 2026-11-07 run as still open / closing-soon.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only: direct portal/document access was blocked this run (ENOTFOUND for acara.edu.au), so deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, value and contacts could not be extracted and are null. Closing date/time confirmed from ACARA's own tenders page listing. Distinct from ACARA's NAP-ICTL 2028 RFT (RFT 5-26), which is invitation-only and out of scope.

tenders.title: Digital Marketplace Panel 2 (DMP2) - reopening for new seller applications (Software and Cloud)
tenders.category: ICT panel / prequalification (digital, software, cloud services)
tenders.description: The DTA is reopening its Digital Marketplace Panel 2 (DMP2) in November 2026 for new seller applications, including under the Software and Cloud module. Existing sellers on the expiring Software and ERP Marketplace and Cloud Marketplace arrangements are expected to re-apply to DMP2 to continue selling to government.
tenders.eligibility: Open to ICT sellers applying to join the panel (new applicants and existing sellers re-applying); application is via a free BuyICT.gov.au seller account.
tenders.briefing: An industry briefing was referenced in reporting but the date could not be confirmed for the 2026 window.
tenders.submission_method: Apply online via BuyICT.gov.au (DTA Digital Marketplace Panel 2)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of DTA/BuyICT buyer-originated announcements and corroborating trade reporting (techpartner.news) indicating DMP2 is reopening in November 2026 for new seller applications. Buyer-originated federal panel (not an aggregator). Pivoted from the news signal to the DTA/BuyICT source of truth.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only; buyict.gov.au and DTA pages could not be opened directly this run (network egress blocked). The exact November-2026 application window (open date, closing date, industry-briefing date) could NOT be confirmed via search and is left null/unverified. DMP2 is a recurring panel that opens for applications more frequently than the original; verify the current window on buyict.gov.au before relying on dates.
